home.description: I build websites, web applications, and landing pages for small businesses. I also work on a variety of personal projects.
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a junior full-stack developer with a passion for technology and software development. I'm currently pursuing my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the Democritus University of Thrace.
about.p2: I hold an ECPE Proficiency certificate in English (C2 Level). I've been coding from 2023, building projects that range from web applications to slight game development.

projects.card1.title: Portfolio Website
projects.card1.desc: A personal portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It showcases my skills, projects, and experience as a full-stack developer. The website is designed to be responsive and visually appealing, providing visitors with an engaging experience.
projects.card2.title: University Project
projects.card2.desc: A university presentation project built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project was created as part of a university assignment and demonstrates my ability to create a visually appealing and interactive web application. The project includes various features such as animations, responsive design, and user interaction.
projects.card3.title: Coming Soon...
projects.card3.desc: Another exciting project coming soon. I'm constantly exploring new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what I can build.
projects.card4.title: Youtube Downloader
projects.card4.desc: A Youtube video & music downloader built with Python for the backend and React for the frontend, offering the ability to easily download your favorite videos and music from YouTube. Created as the final project for CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python.
